app_summary: The application implements a hotel reservation service, built with Go and gRPC. The initial project is extended in several ways, including adding back-end in-memory and persistent databases, adding a recommender system for obtaining hotel recommendations, and adding the functionality to place a hotel reservation.

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The rate service process fails to connect/authenticate to its MongoDB (mongodb-rate) on startup and panics. Concretely, the rate pod (rate-7bdc978679-rnndp) log shows: "server returned error on SASL authentication step: Authentication failed." and a panic, so the rate container crashes (pod in Error state). Because rate is down, gRPC calls to the rate service return Unavailable and that failure propagates through the call chain (search -> geo -> search -> frontend), causing frontend requests to fail with "rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = there is no connection available".

args.root_cause: The rate service process fails to connect/authenticate to its MongoDB (mongodb-rate) on startup and panics. Concretely, the rate pod (rate-7bdc978679-rnndp) log shows: "server returned error on SASL authentication step: Authentication failed." and a panic, so the rate container crashes (pod in Error state). Because rate is down, gRPC calls to the rate service return Unavailable and that failure propagates through the call chain (search -> geo -> search -> frontend), causing frontend requests to fail with "rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = there is no connection available".
args.evidence_summary: 1) Cluster pod list (kubectl get pods) shows rate-7bdc978679-rnndp status 0/1 Error with restarts (4). 2) rate pod logs show: "server returned error on SASL authentication step: Authentication failed." followed by a panic stack trace (main.initializeDatabase ... panic). 3) Traces for frontend returned many errors; example trace (0885ac0208e833b0) shows /rate.Rate/GetRates span with response_code=Unavailable and log message "rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = there is no connection available". 4) get_traces for frontend showed many traces with sequence "frontend -> search -> geo -> search" and the same Unavailable error message. These combine to show rate cannot start due to MongoDB auth failure, making gRPC calls to rate fail and propagate upstream.
args.investigation_summary: I first listed pods/services in namespace test-hotel-reservation to find unhealthy resources. Traces from frontend showed repeated gRPC Unavailable errors in calls that include rate. I inspected pod statuses and found rate in Error with multiple restarts. I fetched rate logs which show a SASL authentication failure to mongodb-rate and an immediate panic crashing the container. I inspected a representative trace and saw the Unavailable error on the /rate.Rate/GetRates span, explaining upstream failures. Root cause localized to the rate service failing to authenticate to its MongoDB and crashing.
